title: Global Expansion: Seagliders in the UAE and Beyond | Versa & ADNOC Logistics & Services
summary: REGENT's international launch customer, Versa AMS, and ADNOC Logistics & Services share their vision for Seagliders in the UAE.
body_markdown: At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, REGENT's international launch customer, Versa AMS, and ADNOC Logistics & Services share their vision for Seagliders in the UAE. George Prensas, CEO of Versa AMS, and Captain Hussam Farrouq Suyyagh, Manager of Business Excellence at ADNOC Logistics & Services, discuss the region's maritime heritage, why the oil and gas industry is interested, and what it means to bring Seaglider operations to Abu Dhabi.
